descricao: Follow the trail east of the Time Base and cross the portal to PREHISTORIC BRAZIL.
recompensa: You went to the Pleistocene and came back in one piece! The ECOMAX sensors are now calibrated.

descricao: Find 2 different species in the tall grass of the Pleistocene. They are recorded in the ECODEX.
recompensa: Two new entries in the ECODEX! This is the start of great research.

descricao: Study 1 creature up close using the TEMPORAL CAPSULE. Tip: SCAN and TRACK before throwing.
recompensa: Your first complete study! Check its Fun Fact and History in the ECODEX.

descricao: Discover 4 different species. Brazil's megafauna was very diverse!
recompensa: Four species discovered. You already see the Pleistocene like a scientist!

descricao: Study 3 species with the TEMPORAL CAPSULE and read what the ECODEX says about them.
recompensa: Three species studied! The ECOMAX will unlock one more capsule for your next expeditions.

descricao: Study ALL the Pleistocene species and complete the ECODEX.
recompensa: All species recorded! You completed the Pleistocene ECODEX.
